entries.6f86a58a720572a1: The brand name is a coined word playing on "youth", and it is a skincare brand for a wide range of age groups. The securities report positions it as the company's core brand. The main product is the single-use, individually packaged serum "Nama VC Bihaku Biyoeki", which contains ascorbic acid (vitamin C), an ingredient recognized for its whitening effect; the report says that efforts to make it known mainly through SNS are under way and that it is the product driving the company's results. In addition, there are an anti-aging care line containing "Nama VA" and a smoothing care line containing "Nama AZ". Sales are mainly through regular subscriptions on the company's own EC site, and it also sells wholesale to drugstores and variety shops. Its share of revenue was approximately 44% in the fiscal year ended March 2026. The amount of revenue by brand is not stated.

entries.8331c7fa6329b537: A mid-price-range beauty appliance brand launched in February 2024. The securities report explains that it offers products that are high-performance and highly designed yet reasonably priced. From launch it has had 2 models of facial devices along with a hair dryer and a hair iron, and the report says that it is also a main brand of the company in terms of revenue. In addition to sales centered on EC sites, it adds wholesale sales to consumer electronics retailers. The amount of revenue by brand is not stated.

entries.ace5eea11791e6f1: The [[term:annual-securities-report|Annual Securities Report]] describes the company's business as a single business, the 'D2C Brand Business.' The company plans and develops products in-house, has them manufactured by OEMs, and sells them to customers through three sales channels: 'own EC site sales,' 'EC mall sales,' and 'wholesale sales to retail stores.' The company explains that its distinctive feature is the use of data accumulated in its in-house AI system 'SELL' across operations from product planning through advertising to handling customer inquiries. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥29,359,038 thousand, up 106.7% year on year.

entries.f3428cc7959e8b42: This is the company's only business (a single segment), in which it sells cosmetics and beauty appliances planned and developed in-house directly to consumers, with manufacturing outsourced to OEM manufacturers. The securities report states that the company uses its in-house AI system 'SELL (seru),' developed for automated advertising management and other purposes, for product development, demand forecasting, advertising, inquiry handling and customer management. Net sales for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥29,359.038 million (up 106.7% year on year), and operating profit was ¥3,802.311 million (up 53.3%). The three main brands are 'Yunth,' 'Brighte,' and 'Straine,' and the share of net sales accounted for by Yunth fell from about 65% in the fiscal year ended March 2025 to about 44% in the fiscal year ended March 2026.
